testcases.expected: click-tracking li fires pre-submit, OTP lead completes with success_toaster shown, submit li fires only after success, and lead_gen.php confirms mobile/category/page/position/lead-type/bd params
steps: # Setup: authenticate on devx and open the devx no-price product-category NCT page explicitly designated for Ask For Price testing
open ${devx}
open ${url_carpet_wholesalers}
wait for result page load
scroll until element get_best_price_any_button visible, scroll by 300 pixels
# Action: start capturing network requests before triggering Ask For Price so the click-tracking li can be asserted
start capturing network requests
click get_best_price_any_button
# Assertion: the open-sheet click-tracking li fires on click
verify network request containing "gbp_afp_b2b_plisting_carousel" was sent
wait until element gbp_sheet_heading is visible
verify element gbp_sheet_heading is visible
# Assertion: the submit li must NOT have fired yet, before the lead is actually submitted
store network request containing "submit__gbp_afp_b2b_plisting_carousel" as submitLiBefore
verify stored submitLiBefore is not "submit__gbp_afp_b2b_plisting_carousel"
# Action: enter mobile number and request OTP for the Ask For Price lead
type "${mobile}" into mobile_number_input
click gbp_submit_now_button
wait until element otp_1st_field is visible
# Action: fetch the OTP from the communication events API and enter it
api get "http://192.168.131.12/communication/api/v1/get_events?mobileEmail=${mobile}&vertical=OTP" as otpResp
store json otpResp path data.response.0.sms.text as otpText
store regex "(\d{4,8})" from otpText as otp
enter otp "${otp}" into otp_fields
# Assertion: lead submission succeeds
verify element success_toaster is visible
# Assertion: the submit click-tracking li fires only AFTER successful lead generation
verify network request containing "submit__gbp_afp_b2b_plisting_carousel" was sent
# Setup: derive city, category and today's date needed by the lead-gen verification API
store regex "justdial\.com/([^/]+)/" from page url as city
store regex "justdial\.com/[^/]+/([^/?]+)/nct-" from page url as category
store lowercase of "${city}" as cityLower
get today as d
format date "${d}" as "YYYY-MM-DD" into today
# Assertion: lead_gen.php confirms the lead was generated with the correct params (dev=1 for devx/staging)
api get "http://192.168.35.197:8111/lead_gen.php?city=${cityLower}&date=${today}&mobile=${mobile}&msg=1&dev=1" as leadGenResp
verify stored leadGenResp contains "${mobile}"
verify stored leadGenResp contains "${category}"
verify stored leadGenResp contains "rsltpge"
verify stored leadGenResp contains "recommended-products"
verify stored leadGenResp contains "get_best_price"
verify stored leadGenResp contains "bd"
testcases.title: Ask For Price CTA on recommended carousel (devx, no-price category - Carpet Wholesalers) submits a lead via mobile+OTP, verified by click-tracking li's and lead_gen.php API
